topic: Standard units, laboratory tools, and data organization
key_concepts: Standard SI units are used for physical quantities such as mass, length, volume, time, and
Mass is measured with instruments like electronic balance and triple beam balance
Length is measured with tools such as ruler and measuring tape
Volume is measured using beaker and graduated cylinder
Time is measured with digital clock and stopwatch
Temperature is measured with thermometer and digital thermometer
Appropriate SI units include kilogram for mass, meter for length, liter for volume, second
Scientists organize data using tables, narrative notes, graphs, and diagrams
Data tables have columns or rows for independent and dependent variables
In tables and line graphs, the independent variable is placed first or on the x-axis and t
Line graphs visually show data trends such as boiling point increasing as air pressure inc
Repeated measurement trials and averaging help improve accuracy in scientific measurement
